additional_context: The Vector Institute is an independent, not-for-profit Canadian research organization focused on artificial intelligence (AI), with particular strength in machine learning and deep learning.
Launched in March 2017 with support from the Government of Canada, Government of Ontario, and private industry, in partnership with the University of Toronto and other universities.
Collaborates with institutions, industry, start-ups, incubators, and accelerators to advance AI research and drive its application, adoption, and commercialization across Canada.

The role of Machine Learning Specialist involves developing reusable software to apply and scale AI research breakthroughs, collaborating with ML engineering staff, data scientists, and industry/health organizations.
Responsibilities include designing and developing reference applications and model templates, contributing to open-source software, and mentoring industry sponsor staff.

Key technical skills for a Machine Learning Specialist include strong Python programming, experience with ML and statistics, experience applying ML research to novel problems, experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace, JAX, CUDA), and a data engineering background working with real-world data.
Prior experience with parameter and architecture tuning of deep learning algorithms is preferred.
Proficiency in software engineering best practices, version control systems, and collaborative development environments is important.
The institute has an AI Engineering Team to ramp up applied AI for sponsors and partners.
Offers a Machine Learning Associates (MLA) program for students and recent graduates to work on real-world AI implementations with Canadian start-ups.
The company has approximately 379 employees worldwide as of March 2026, with growth in Finance and Operations, Engineering, and Sales and Marketing departments.
